name: Kickresume
notes: Resume builder for job seekers; no employer job posting or employer pricing found. Pricing page lists candidate subscriptions (Yearly $8 / month, Quarterly $18 / month, Monthly $24 / month). Footer shows Terms, Privacy Policy and Cookie Settings; no API, developer or partner page linked.

review.note: Home, About and Pricing pages read (HTTP 200); they state an EU-based team in Bratislava and candidate subscriptions but no employer pricing, parent, API or partner program.
